'''''Dunns''''' was a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] serving the [[Mugaari pirates]]. It participated in the [[Battle of the Tungra sector]]. Where it was destroyed along with all the other Mugaari ships at a [[Mugaari cargo loading area|cargo loading area]] doing an arms deal between the pirates and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] located in the [[Tungra sector/Legends|Tungra sector]].
